sentences.text: Carbon -LRB- from carbo `` coal '' -RRB- is a chemical element with symbol C and atomic number 6 .	chemical element	chemical element	symbol	Symbol (chemistry)	atomic number	atomic number	coal	coal
It is nonmetallic and tetravalent -- making four electrons available to form covalent chemical bonds .	tetravalent	tetravalence	covalent	covalent bond

Three isotopes occur naturally , C and C being stable , while C is a radioactive isotope , decaying with a half-life of about 5,730 years .	isotopes	Isotopes of carbon	radioactive isotope	Radionuclide	half-life	half-life
Carbon is one of the few elements known since antiquity .	few elements known since antiquity	Discoveries of the chemical elements

Carbon is the 15th most abundant element in the Earth 's crust , and the fourth most abundant element in the universe by mass after hydrogen , helium , and oxygen .	fourth most abundant element in the universe by mass	Abundance of the chemical elements	hydrogen	hydrogen	helium	helium	oxygen	oxygen	Earth	Earth

Carbon 's abundance , its unique diversity of organic compounds , and its unusual ability to form polymers at the temperatures commonly encountered on Earth enables this element to serve as a common element of all known life .	Earth	Earth	all known life	Carbon-based life	compounds	chemical compound
It is the second most abundant element in the human body by mass -LRB- about 18.5 % -RRB- after oxygen .	oxygen	oxygen	human body	human body
The atoms of carbon can bond together in different ways , termed allotropes of carbon .	allotropes of carbon	allotropes of carbon
The best known are graphite , diamond , and amorphous carbon .	graphite	graphite	diamond	diamond	amorphous carbon	amorphous carbon
The physical properties of carbon vary widely with the allotropic form .	physical properties	physical properties
For example , graphite is opaque and black while diamond is highly transparent .	graphite	graphite	diamond	diamond	opaque	Opacity (optics)	transparent	Transparency (optics)

Graphite is soft enough to form a streak on paper -LRB- hence its name , from the Greek verb '' γράφειν '' which means `` to write '' -RRB- , while diamond is the hardest naturally occurring material known .	diamond	diamond
Graphite is a good electrical conductor while diamond has a low electrical conductivity .	diamond	diamond	electrical conductor	electrical conductor	electrical conductivity	electrical conductivity

Under normal conditions , diamond , carbon nanotubes , and graphene have the highest thermal conductivities of all known materials .	diamond	diamond	graphene	graphene	thermal conductivities	thermal conductivity	all known materials	List of thermal conductivities
All carbon allotropes are solids under normal conditions , with graphite being the most thermodynamically stable form .	graphite	graphite	thermodynamically stable	Thermodynamic equilibrium
They are chemically resistant and require high temperature to react even with oxygen .	oxygen	oxygen

The most common oxidation state of carbon in inorganic compounds is +4 , while +2 is found in carbon monoxide and transition metal carbonyl complexes .	oxidation state	oxidation state	carbon monoxide	carbon monoxide	transition metal	transition metal	carbonyl	Metal carbonyl	compounds	chemical compound

The largest sources of inorganic carbon are limestones , dolomites and carbon dioxide , but significant quantities occur in organic deposits of coal , peat , oil , and methane clathrates .	carbon dioxide	carbon dioxide	coal	coal	peat	peat	oil	petroleum

Carbon forms a vast number of compounds , more than any other element , with almost ten million compounds described to date , and yet that number is but a fraction of the number of theoretically possible compounds under standard conditions .	compounds	chemical compound
For this reason , carbon has often been referred to as the `` king of the elements '' .
